name: Hao Peng
affiliation: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China
bio: I am Hao Peng, affiliated with the University of Electronic Science and Technology of China (UESTC). My published work focuses on thick cloud removal in multitemporal remote sensing images, combining deep learning with low-rank tensor models and data-aware regularization.

publications.title: A Unified Data-Aware Fidelity and Regularization Learning Paradigm for Thick Cloud Removal of Multitemporal Remote Sensing Images
publications.venue: IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing
publications.summary: Data-aware fidelity and regularization learning for thick cloud removal in multitemporal remote sensing images.

publications.title: Deep Domain Fidelity and Low-Rank Tensor Ring Regularization for Thick Cloud Removal of Multitemporal Remote Sensing Images
publications.venue: IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing
publications.summary: Deep-domain fidelity and low-rank tensor ring regularization for restoring cloud-obscured multitemporal remote sensing images.
